structured_output.what_is_happening: "The Undying Hamster" ($Dalguddi) is a 3-hour-old pump.fun coin still on the bonding curve, at about $12k market cap (58.6 of about 115 virtual SOL). In the last hour its price rose 157-171% on about $18.7k of volume and 112 unique buyers. The spike looks tied to an X post by QuantKeef (status 2103036136902021452), which is listed as the coin's twitter on GeckoTerminal, and pump.fun also references a user named rato0505. I could not read the post because X returned HTTP 402. Several copies with the same ticker have already appeared: 'Immortal Hamster' and 'Sisyphean Hamster' versions, one with $49.8k of volume in the last hour. That suggests a small meme story is circulating on crypto X. The deployer has launched 57 tokens, and the best of them peaked at about $70k market cap.

narrative.why_spreading: Most likely a single X post (QuantKeef) set off a burst of ticker launches. Copies named Immortal and Sisyphean Hamster show that launch bots and degen traders are chasing it. I found no evidence of attention outside crypto.

token_connection.why_this_token: It was the earliest 'Dalguddi' launch (pair created 1790237881, before the Immortal Hamster copies at 1790238010 and later). It is also the only one with meaningful market cap, and GeckoTerminal links it to the QuantKeef post.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 5 other Dalguddi/hamster tokens. D59bQx... (Sisyphean Hamster) had $49.8k of volume in the last hour but only $3.3k market cap, and EC5XEs... had $12.9k. The competitors are splitting the flow.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN tags 94 bundler wallets and 85 fresh wallets, the bot/degen rate is 30%, and the top bundler trader share is 11%. The deployer is a serial launcher with 57 tokens. structured_output.thesis: This is a micro-cap meme on the pump.fun curve, riding a small X-sourced hamster story, and it is the earliest and leading ticker among its copies. The deployer is a serial launcher and bundler activity is heavy. Doubling from $12k is cheap, but the entry comes after a 3x hourly spike, and serial-dev coins usually peak below about $70k and bleed. The chance of doubling is meaningful but below break-even.
